operator_notes: PDF Embedder shows weekly PDFs as canvases (no a.pdfemb-viewer href) — harvester reads network *.pdf URLs.
Newest current-week PDF is preferred (e.g. 26th-July-2026.pdf). Ignore Volunteer-EOI.
Site SSL certificate is often expired — host profile sets ignore_https_errors.
do_not: Do not hardcode one dated PDF URL — it changes every week.
Do not download Volunteer-EOI or other non-bulletin PDFs on the page.
Do not wait forever for a.pdfemb-viewer[href] — this site uses canvas embeds.
